evidence.locator: Section 2.3, Injection Molding of the Blends

product_form.notes: Specimen type designation and dimensions are not stated; no dimensions are inferred from a cited standard.

processing.text: PLA was introduced into a Brabender Plastograph internal mixer at 190 degrees C and 80 rpm, then PCL was added; these conditions were maintained until constant torque. Blends were pelletized in a knife mill with a 10-mm mesh and injection-molded using source-named Aurburg 220 M 350-90U equipment.

evidence.locator: Sections 2.2-2.3 and 3.1

processing.notes: Section 2.3 lists five heating zones at 175, 180, 185, 185 and 190 degrees C and an injection-pressure range of 330-600 bar. Section 3.1 says both injection-molding temperature and pressure were modified according to blend melt flow index. Retain these as reported setup/range context only; exact per-formulation temperature and pressure settings are unresolved, and no universal molding recipe is assigned to the seven states.

temper_or_heat_treatment.text: Materials were dried at 60 degrees C until constant weight before processing. Pelletized blends were kept in a 60 degrees C oven to prevent moisture absorption.

evidence.locator: Sections 2.1-2.2
